Excuse me, I tried to pay for parking at the machine, but it doesn't seem to be working.
It won't accept cash or my credit card.
Oh, I'm sorry.
The machine is currently out of order.
There was supposed to be a sign posted about that, but you can pay me here at the booth.
Okay.
I entered the parking garage 45 minutes ago, so how much do I owe?
If you've been here under an hour, parking is free, but I still need to validate your parking ticket so you can exit.
context.transcript_translation:
不好意思，我试着用机器支付停车费，但它似乎没在工作。
它不接受现金或我的信用卡。
哦，对不起。
这台机器目前无法使用。
本该贴有告示的，但你可以在这里的柜台付钱给我。
好的。
我是在 45 分钟前进入停车场的，那我欠多少钱？
如果你在这里不到一小时，停车是免费的，但我仍然需要验证你的停车票才能让你离开。
